component.name: Ferret
component.summary: Continue what you were doing on your other devices

description.p: Start something on your phone and pick it up on your computer. Ferret carries what you are doing between your own devices: the page you are reading, the song or podcast at the same second, your clipboard, files, notifications, texts and calls.
It works on your local network, between Android, iOS, macOS, Linux and Windows. Devices talk to each other directly, end-to-end encrypted. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.

ul.li: Copy on one device, paste on another
Send files from the file manager with “Send with Ferret”, or drop them on a device
Read and answer your phone’s texts and notifications on your computer
Open the page you were reading on your phone, right where you left it
A tray icon, start at login, and a command line with JSON output for scripts

screenshot.caption: Your devices on the left, the one you picked on the right
Activity: what just happened, with the one thing to do about it
Pair a device by comparing six digits

ul.li: Your devices are the home screen: send files, send the clipboard or ring a device from its row
Pair by comparing six digits. No QR code to scan, no account
Clipboard, files, notifications, texts, calls and media between your devices
Flaky Wi-Fi handled: transfers pause and go on by themselves
A tray icon, start at login, keyboard shortcuts, and ferret-cli for scripts
